question: Soil erosion is one of the major threats to the environment. Which of the following can help to prevent erosion of soil?
solution:
The correct answer is **Contour ploughing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Contour ploughing** is a farming practice that involves ploughing and planting across a slope following its elevation contour lines.
 
• These contour lines create a water break, which significantly reduces the formation of rills and gullies during rainstorms, thus preventing soil erosion.
